cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.24)
project(BuggDependencyCore VERSION 1.0.0 LANGUAGES CXX)
file(READ "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/runtime-rules.json" BUGG_RUNTIME_RULES)
configure_file(runtime_rules.h.in runtime_rules.h @ONLY)

add_library(bugg_dependency_core STATIC version.cpp fabric_version.cpp check.cpp metadata.cpp)
target_compile_features(bugg_dependency_core PUBLIC cxx_std_20)
target_include_directories(bugg_dependency_core PUBLIC include)
target_include_directories(bugg_dependency_core PRIVATE third_party "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}")
set_target_properties(bugg_dependency_core PROPERTIES POSITION_INDEPENDENT_CODE ON)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(bugg_dependency_core PRIVATE /utf-8)
endif()

option(BUGG_DEPENDENCY_C_ABI "Build the service C ABI library" ${PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL})
if(BUGG_DEPENDENCY_C_ABI)
    add_library(bugg_dependency SHARED abi.cpp)
    target_link_libraries(bugg_dependency PRIVATE bugg_dependency_core)
    target_compile_features(bugg_dependency PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
endif()
if(PROJECT_IS_TOP_LEVEL)
    include(CTest)
    if(BUILD_TESTING)
        add_executable(dependency_core_test tests/version_test.cpp)
        target_link_libraries(dependency_core_test PRIVATE bugg_dependency_core)
        add_test(NAME dependency_core_test COMMAND dependency_core_test)
        add_executable(dependency_check_test tests/check_test.cpp)
        target_include_directories(dependency_check_test PRIVATE third_party)
        target_link_libraries(dependency_check_test PRIVATE bugg_dependency_core)
        add_test(NAME dependency_check_test COMMAND dependency_check_test)
    endif()
endif()
